answer_2.quote: We use rating accuracy to evaluate the graders. On Vibe-Eval, we use Spearman correlation between automatic graders and human graders as our evaluation metric.

answer_3.quote: We evaluate automatic graders by having LM-based graders (Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo) assign a preference between two candidate model responses.

answer_4.quote: We collect human ratings for each pairwise comparison; each comparison receives approximately five human ratings, and raters evaluate based on fulfillment, groundedness, and presentation quality.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters evaluate responses according to specified criteria such as fulfillment, groundedness, and presentation quality.
